string.text: The H&K G11 was a non-production prototype assault rifle developed during the late Cold War in West Germany, with a sleek, futuristic design complemented by an ergonomic layout, allowing for superior handling, high rate of fire and modularity in diverse combat scenarios. Development ended succesfully in 1990 with 1000 produced units, but it was abandoned during the German reunification.\n This 5.56mm variant is a redesign that adapts the original feeding system for caseless ammunition for conventional NATO ammo to blend cutting-edge design with the power and reliability of a conventional NATO round, featuring advanced materials and a streamlined profile that make it lighter and more adaptable.\n
Magazine for the H&K G11 battle rifle, holds 45 rounds of 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition. \n \n
